recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for this issue unless future work adds automated validation for search page examples.
issue_request: FHIR-34162 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I correction request for the core search page asking to replace the invalid `user` search parameter in `GET [base]/Patient?_has:Observation:patient:_has:AuditEvent:entity:user=MyUserId` with `agent`.
initial_application: No explicit Jira-keyed source commit was found, but git history shows commit 83529ed121dc9fc1d9aeb117b0fe8a6293f9f0c9 changed the example from `AuditEvent:entity:user` to `AuditEvent:entity:agent` on 2022-01-21, immediately after the FHIR-I vote.
additional_context: The cited Zulip thread confirms the same error and proposed correction, FHIR-I WGM minutes record the FHIR-34162 Persuasive 11-0-0 vote, and the current AuditEvent search parameter source defines `agent` as an active reference search parameter over `AuditEvent.agent.who`.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because `source/search.html` already contains the requested `agent` example in both GET and POST forms and the old exact `AuditEvent:entity:user` example is no longer present on the search page.
